test_title: PYST 46: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the italicised word.

If you feel good, then you will ***portray* **that attitude and look fabulous no matter what!
solution:
The correct answer is Depict.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'portray' means depict (someone or something) in a work of art or literature.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Distort- Pull or twist out of shape in.
 
• Garble- To so alter or distort as to create a wrong impression or change the meaning
 
• Falsify- Alter (information, a document, or evidence) so as to mislead
 
• *Depict- Represent by a drawing, painting, or other art form.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym to substitute 'portray' is 'depict'.
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.
